text: The .remember operation ingests text, files, or URLs in one call, auto-chunking, extracting entities, and building a knowledge graph
quote: Give Cognee text, files, or URLs. It ingests, chunks, extracts entities, and builds the knowledge graph for you in one call.

text: remember() can write directly into a per-session cache for fast short-term retrieval during a conversation
quote: cognee.remember(data, session_id="my_session") — writes content directly into the session cache for fast retrieval.

text: A session, keyed by (user_id, session_id), stores an ordered list of recent interactions as short-term memory
quote: A session is Cognee's short-term memory for a specific user. It is identified by `(user_id, session_id)` and stores an ordered list of recent interactions.

text: .recall is the main retrieval entry point, searching memory via the best available source for the request
quote: The `.recall` operation is the main retrieval entry point in Cognee v1.0. It searches memory using the best available source for the request.

text: When no search type is given, recall() automatically classifies the query and picks the best retrieval strategy
quote: when you do not specify a search type, `recall()` classifies the query and picks the best retrieval strategy automatically

text: .improve enriches an existing knowledge graph after data has already been ingested
quote: The `.improve` operation enriches an existing Cognee graph after data has already been ingested.

text: improve() can be run at the end of a session to bridge short-term session memory into permanent long-term memory
quote: Use `improve()` after Remember when you want to enrich an existing graph further. Use it at the end of a chat or agent session to bridge short-term session memory into permanent memory.

text: .forget is the unified deletion command, supporting single-item, whole-dataset, or full user-scope cleanup deletion
quote: Single data item deletion: remove one data item from a dataset. Dataset deletion: remove an entire dataset and its graph/vector data. Full cleanup: remove everything the current user can delete.

text: The cognee-cli tool lets you remember data, enrich memory, and query — all from the terminal without writing Python
quote: lets you run Cognee from the terminal so you can remember data, enrich memory, and ask questions without opening a Python file

text: cognee-cli push uploads a local dataset's knowledge graph to Cognee Cloud
quote: `cognee-cli push` uploads a local dataset's knowledge graph to Cognee Cloud

text: cognee-cli report generates a Graph Insight Report summarizing what a dataset's knowledge graph contains
quote: `cognee-cli report` writes a Graph Insight Report describing what a dataset's graph contains

text: Cognee can be run as a single Docker container for local development, testing, or custom deployment
quote: Quick start with Docker (single command): docker run --env-file ./.env -p 8000:8000 --rm -it cognee/cognee:main

text: An optional RDF/OWL ontology file can be supplied to align extracted entities and types to canonical domain concepts
quote: An ontology is an optional RDF/OWL file you can provide to Cognee. It acts as a reference vocabulary, making sure that entity types...are linked to canonical, well-defined concepts.

text: Dataset-scoped permissions and per-dataset storage give multi-user/org data isolation and access control on one instance
quote: This system provides data isolation and access control through dataset-scoped permissions and per-dataset storage, enabling multiple users or organizations to use the same Cognee instance while keeping their data completely separate.

text: cognee.start_ui() runs the full UI and pipelines locally, for free, with no account required
quote: you can also run the UI and all pipelines entirely on your own machine for free, with no account required, using `cognee.start_ui()`

text: The browser UI lets you upload data, explore knowledge graphs, run searches, and manage datasets
quote: Upload data, explore knowledge graphs, run searches, and manage datasets through the browser.

text: Cognee is open source and can run the full memory engine locally or on your own infrastructure for free, forever
quote: Cognee is open source. Run the full memory engine locally or on your own stack — free, forever.

text: An official Cognee MCP server brings persistent AI memory into MCP-compatible tools like Claude, Cursor, Cline, Continue, and Codex
quote: Cognee MCP brings persistent AI memory to your workflow through the Model Context Protocol.

text: Cognee connects to Slack, Notion, Linear, and Google Drive to bring company data sources into agent-accessible memory
quote: Data source integrations: Slack, Notion, Linear, Google Drive

text: Cognee can index code repositories into memory
quote: Code indexing for your repos
